# AmbassadorsCloud

> Digital home of the JKUSDA Ambassadors Choir. Members share music, photos, videos, and documents; the public can listen to performances and browse the events calendar.

AmbassadorsCloud is the official platform for the JKUSDA Ambassadors Choir community. Approved music and videos are public; photos and documents are reserved for choir members.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the choir and the platform.
- [Media Gallery](/gallery): Public approved music and video performances.
- [Events](/events): Calendar of practices, performances, and tour dates.
- [Sign In](/login): Member sign in.
- [Join Choir](/register): New member registration.

## Optional

- [Member Dashboard](/dashboard): Authenticated member overview.
- [Upload](/upload): Members upload photos, music, videos, and documents for admin approval.
